title: Undergraduate Research Program (University of Delaware)
description:
The University of Delaware's Undergraduate Research Program is the campus hub for getting involved in research and creative scholarship across every college and major. It connects students with faculty mentors, funding awards, summer programs, and the annual symposium, and guides them from first exploring research to presenting their own work.

description: The University of Delaware Research Apprenticeship (UDRAW) pairs first- and second-year students with an experienced student researcher and faculty mentor to learn the fundamentals of research early in their undergraduate career.
